summary: Show read-only retained request history in iOS discussions and allow independent discussions from resolved Inbox items

replay.detail: The iOS client consumes the shared generated RequestHistoryPage; it does not fold claims or lifecycle events.

schema.detail: Uses canonical generated threadRequestHistory and threadStartContext reads without changing server schemas or actions.

rules.detail: History is explanatory only. Exact source episodes retain their own status, answer, original payload and authorized predecessor reason. Missing original payload remains unavailable. Related history does not grant answer authority or change request status. Current-source navigation requires a matching source and episode on an active server-listed card; closed cached episodes never prove a current target. Each Start creates an independent discussion, never an origin-coalesced continuation. The recipient presentation displays the generated context's exact agent ID and basis before the composer can send, independently of original source attribution or roster presence; the send signs that same agent ID.

compatibility.detail: History is loaded on demand one bounded authorized page at a time; continuation replaces prior content and read failures remove prior private rows. External content remains a reference, not a historical snapshot. Canonical fallback explicitly identifies a NEW discussion and leaves original history and participants unchanged; offline original recipients are not inferred retired. A definitive recipient refusal refreshes context, clears the old recipient while loading, visibly warns of change, and requires another user Send. Unknown-delivery retries retain their exact signed recipient and request rather than refreshing or retargeting. No local retirement inference, raw JSON parsing, alternate lifecycle fold or production network stub is added. Source tests do not replace live backend admission proof.

downtime.detail: No migration or native build is required by these source changes.

manual.detail: No new mission, agent, permission scope, or ready mutation.

recovery.detail: Merge the reviewed #6636 draft protections: owner/generation-fenced completion handling, dispatch snapshots and compare-delete preserve newer typing and prevent old-owner persistence. Delivery identities include source, episode and thread UUID; persisted attempt slots retain the UUID-based recovery format. In-process receipts retry only the original request. Restored attempts without receipts expose Copy/Discard and an unknown-delivery warning, never reconstruct a send or infer a current recipient.
